categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in five major business segments: Chinese medicinal herbs integration, TCM decoction pieces, concentrated TCM granules, TCM finished drugs, and TCM great health. These segments encompass the sourcing, processing, manufacturing, and sales of traditional Chinese medicine products and related health services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including quality control systems, standardized production methods such as Good Agricultural Practice (GAP) for medicinal herbs, and digital traceability platforms. It integrates scientific research, process innovation, and evidence-based medicine approaches, supported by national drug standards and proprietary R&D in TCM formulations and granules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include medical institutions, hospitals, pharmacies, and end consumers of TCM products. The company serves the healthcare and pharmaceutical industries, focusing on both prescription and over-the-counter markets, as well as TCM medical institutions and health product consumers in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in the People's Republic of China, with production bases and distribution centers across 22 provinces and regions. It also explores overseas markets for international product registration and certification, but its core operations and markets are domestic within China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the TCM supply chain, including upstream cultivation and integration of Chinese medicinal herbs, midstream processing into decoction pieces and concentrated granules, and downstream manufacturing and sales of finished drugs and health products. It also provides related medical services, positioning itself as a vertically integrated player.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include technological innovation, standardization, digital transformation, and sustainable development. R&D focuses on improving quality standards, developing innovative and classical TCM drugs, evidence-based clinical research, and expanding national drug standards. The company also emphasizes talent development and ESG integration to drive high-quality growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales across its five business segments, including raw medicinal herbs, processed decoction pieces, concentrated granules, finished drugs, and health products. The company also derives income from pharmaceutical services and medical institution operations, supported by government grants and subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the traditional Chinese medicine industry in China, maintaining a dominant market share especially in concentrated TCM granules and decoction pieces. It competes with other major TCM manufacturers and pharmaceutical companies, leveraging its scale, technological innovation, and comprehensive product portfolio to sustain its industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue of approximately RMB16.51 billion in 2024, with a compound annual growth rate of 2.76% over five years. Despite a recent decline in profitability due to market and policy pressures, it maintains substantial total assets of over RMB35 billion and equity exceeding RMB21 billion. The company is undergoing transformation to stabilize growth and improve efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product quality, standardization, and innovation as its core value propositions. It differentiates through a vertically integrated supply chain, extensive quality control, adherence to national standards, and a strong brand portfolio including recognized time-honored brands. Its digital traceability and scientific research capabilities enhance product reliability and clinical efficacy, supporting customer trust and market leadership.
